_comment: Sample profile, entered through the same schema as any user's. Fields starting with _ are notes and are ignored by the validator; any other unknown field is rejected. A field is present only where a manufacturer page was read on 2026-11-05 (see _source); absent fields are unknown and optics reports them as missing. Elevation is unknown. Filters, camera windows and read-noise class added 2026-11-07 from ~/Token/docs/reference/equipment.md (owner list, sizes as the owner states them) and ~/Token/research/astro-filters-owned.md, filter-choice.md, equipment-specs.json (web reads 2026-11-06); a filter or camera value is absent where the research found none.

sites.name: Fountain Hills, AZ
sites._source: Owner-entered; arc and height from the owner (2026-11-05).

accessories.name: Celestron HyperStar v4
accessories._source: starizona.com/products/hyperstar-c11-v4 (read 2026-11-05): f/1.9, 540 mm for the C11. HyperStar replaces the secondary mirror, so this is the whole scope's focal length, not a multiplier. A different Starizona page lists 684 mm for a C11 HyperStar without naming v4; not used.

accessories.name: Celestron 0.7x focal reducer
accessories._source: Factor is in the product name: celestron.com/products/reducer-lens-7x-edgehd-1100 (Reducer Lens .7x EdgeHD 11)

accessories.name: TeleVue 2.5x Powermate
accessories._source: Factor is in the product name (Tele Vue Powermate 2.5x)

cameras.name: ZWO ASI2600MC Duo
cameras._source: zwoastro.com/product/asi2600mc-duo/: 3.76um pixel, resolution 6248x4176. Added 2026-11-07: Duo window is UV/IR-cut (zwoastro.com/product/zwo-protective-window-for-asi-cameras: D60 UV/IR-cut for ASI2600MC Pro/Duo); read noise 0.9 to 4.2 e by gain (zwoastro.com/product/asi2600mc-duo/); MC = one-shot colour

cameras.name: ZWO ASI533MC
cameras._source: zwoastro.com/product/asi533/: pixel size 3.76um, resolution 3008x3008. Added 2026-11-07: 533 window is anti-reflection only, no UV/IR cut (zwoastro.com/product/zwo-protective-window-for-asi-cameras lists D32 AR for the ASI533 series); read noise about 1.0 e (zwoastro.com/product/asi533-pro-series/); MC = one-shot colour

cameras.name: ZWO ASI676MC
cameras._source: zwoastro.com/product/asi676/: pixel size 2um, resolution 3552x3552. Added 2026-11-07: 676MC window is UV/IR-cut coated (zwoastro.com/product/asi676/); read noise 0.56 to 2.9 e (manual); MC = one-shot colour

filters.name: Astronomik CLS CCD
filters.bandpassNotes: Passes 450 to 520 nm and 640 to 690 nm; blocks about 520 to 640 nm
filters._source: astronomik.com/en/Light-Pollution-Filters/CLS-CCD/ and /Astronomik-CLS-CCD-2-M48/10208200 (read 2026-11-06): bands 450-520 and 640-690 nm (70 + 50 nm), integrated IR-blocking layer, suitable for f/1.8 to f/15. Size: owner list (2" M48).

filters.name: ZWO Duo-Band
filters._source: zwoastro.com/product/duo-band-filters (read 2026-11-06): Ha 15 nm, OIII 35 nm, incident angle should be less than 8 degrees. UV/IR cut not listed, so blocksUvIr is left unknown. Size: owner list.

filters.name: ICE 2" light-pollution filter
filters._source: Owner list only. Possibly ICE LiPo (didymium, broadband), not confirmed, so the kind is left unknown too; no passband, UV/IR or f-ratio data published, so those are left unknown (astro-filters-owned.md section 3).

filters.name: IDAS LPS-P2
filters._source: Owner list. Broadband light-pollution filter (cloudbreakoptics.com via search summary); UV/IR cut, passband width and f-ratio rating not found, left unknown.

filters.name: IDAS LPS-P3
filters._source: Owner says 52 mm (confirmed 2026-11-07; vendors list 48 mm, check the rim). UV and NIR blocking per vendors (starizona.com/products/idas-lps-p3, via search summary, VENDOR). No passband width or f-ratio rating found, left unknown.

filters.name: Apertura Moon and Skyglow
filters._source: Owner list (size as the owner states it). Sold as a visual eyepiece filter, 1.25" (highpointscientific.com/apertura-1-25-moon-and-skyglow-filter); no passband published, UV/IR unknown.

filters.name: Orion Sky Glow
filters._source: Owner list. Kind left unknown: Orion sells both a visual Sky Glow Broadband and a SkyGlow imaging filter (astro-filters-owned.md section 3); check the box.

filters.name: Orion Skyglow Ultrablock
filters.bandpassNotes: UHC-type: passes Hb, OIII, Ha; blocks mercury and sodium 99.9%; passband width not published
filters._source: Owner list. telescopicwatch.com/orion-ultrablock-narrowband-filter-review/ (page read) covers visual use only; Orion says not generally for photography (search summary). Kind visual-only follows astro-filters-owned.md (visual-first). UV/IR unknown.

filters.name: Baader neodymium Moon and Skyglow
filters._source: Owner list. Neodymium-doped glass, a visual-contrast filter; IR-cut coated per Baader datasheet via search summary (agenaastro.com, VENDOR). Kind visual-only follows astro-filters-owned.md (Moon and planets only, opinion).

filters.name: Baader UV/IR cut
filters.bandpassNotes: 420 to 685 nm (CMOS-optimised) or 420 to 680 nm (older); which one is owned is not recorded
filters._source: eu.lunaticoastro.com/?p=1614 (page read: 420 to 680 nm) and optcorp.com / astronome.fr (CMOS 420 to 685 nm, f/15 to f/1.8, retailers); width 260 nm is the narrower version. Size: owner list.

filters.name: Optolong H-alpha 7 nm
filters._source: Owner list (added 2026-11-07, size to confirm; 48 mm per the owner's all-48 statement). Bandwidth is in the product name. UV/IR cut and f-ratio rating not researched, left unknown.

filters.name: Optolong L-eXtreme (standard)
filters._source: Owner list (standard version, no F2; size 48 mm per the owner's all-48 statement). 7 nm Ha and OIII, blocking 300 to 1000 nm (telescopescanada.ca / highpointscientific.com listings, VENDOR). The standard version's f-ratio rating was not found, left unknown; the F2 version is rated f/2 to f/3.3 (optolong.com/cms/document/detail/id/279.html), so the standard is judged by the shift formula.

smartScopes.name: ZWO Seestar S50
smartScopes._source: zwoastro.com/product/seestar-s50/: aperture 50mm, focal length 250mm, resolution 1920x1080. Pixel size not read on that page; left unknown.

smartScopes.name: ZWO Seestar S50 Pro
smartScopes._source: zwoastro.com/product/seestar-s50-pro/: 50mm aperture. Other specs not read; left unknown.
